answer: Admission is paid in orthogonal observation. A joiner submits twelve live readings: sparrow counts, zephyr phase drift, glacier tick-rate. The registry projects each new vector onto a running basis, crediting only residual amplitude above 0.68. One newcomer leaves near-full signal; twelve puppets cloned from one operator leave 0.04 each and are refused. Seating 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 independent channels, since each clone's residual shrinks as one over the square root of its siblings while projection cost grows quadratically. A projector cannot manufacture the light it starves of.
